scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bronson/types && concurrently -n orch,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bronson/orchestrator" "npm run dev -w @bronson/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bronson/types && npm run build -w @bronson/orchestrator && npm run build -w @bronson/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bronson/types && npm run typecheck -w @bronson/orchestrator && npm run typecheck -w @bronson/web
